rule: product.sku is globally unique within a tenant (products_sku_unique); two products with the same sku violate the constraint.
product.price is an integer cents column (NOT NULL, no float).
product.uomId references units_of_measure ON DELETE RESTRICT; a UOM in use by a product cannot be deleted.
product_stock has at most one row per (productId,branchId) (product_stock_product_branch_unique).
adjustStock with a negative delta that would drive quantity below zero is rejected (BAD_REQUEST 'Insufficient stock'); stock can never go negative.
Every successful adjustStock appends exactly one append-only stock_movements row with delta=applied signed delta and quantityAfter=resulting product_stock.quantity (migration 0079).

Transfer stock moves ONLY at completeTransfer (acceptance): source -quantityTransferred, destination +quantityReceived, each a stock_movements row reason 'transfer_order'; markReceived moves no stock.
Tax rate stored in basis points (800=8.00%, 0=exempt); taxAmount=floor(orderAmount*rateBps/10000).
At most one tax rate has isDefault=true at a time; createTaxRate(isDefault) and setDefaultTaxRate clear the prior default in the same tx.
deactivateTaxRate on the current default does NOT throw; it sets isActive=false AND clears isDefault to false.
tax_rates.code is unique within a tenant (tax_rates_code_idx).
brand.name is unique within a tenant (brands_name_unique).
product_categories.name and externalCode are each unique within a tenant.
units_of_measure.name is unique within a tenant; a UOM referenced as baseUomId by another (ON DELETE RESTRICT) cannot be deleted.
(supplierId,invoiceNumber) is unique — duplicate invoice numbers per supplier violate supplier_invoices_number_unique.
3-way match succeeds only when |PO-receipt|,|PO-invoice|,|receipt-invoice| are all within tolerance=max(toleranceCents|100,1% of PO total); else '3-way match failed'.
Supplier-invoice figures are editable only while pending or disputed; editing matched/paid throws 'Cannot edit a {status} invoice'.
Damaged units do not enter sellable stock: createReceipt increments product_stock by (quantityReceived - quantityDamaged) only.
Only a draft PO can be approved; only draft/approved can be cancelled; receiveItems clamps received qty to (orderedQty-receivedQty) so receivedQty never exceeds orderedQty.
Source and destination branches must differ (zod refine); status machine: markReceived only from in_transit; completeTransfer only from received_pending_acceptance|in_transit.
bufferTimeMinutes must not exceed defaultDuration and is capped at 480 (zod refine); upsert is 1:1 per categoryId via ON CONFLICT.

rule: Commission for an appointment is computed at most once: an existing non-void split for the appointmentId (or linked salesOrderId) skips re-creation.

At most one tenant-wide config (branch_id NULL) and one per branch — partial unique indexes; cycle_type CHECK with anchor_day ranges per type.
A customer's CLAIMED status = (is_unclaimed AND NOT user.emailVerified); is_unclaimed alone is stale by design, so a customer with emailVerified=true renders as claimed regardless of is_unclaimed.
members.userId is unique via INDEX (members_user_idx), NOT a CONSTRAINT; a second member with the same userId in one org must fail at the application layer (CONFLICT), not the DB.
trainer↔service assignment is managed trainer-side via TrainerServicesSection, NOT the service detail dialog; assigning the same (memberId,serviceId) twice is a no-op (onConflictDoNothing).
The last admin of an org must NOT be removable: remove() surfaces 'Cannot remove last admin' as BAD_REQUEST.
Non-admin actors may only mutate members whose hierarchyScopeId∈accessibleNodeIds; admins bypass node-scope checks.
customerDirectory list/getStats/getById return only customers whose hierarchyScopeId∈accessibleNodeIds; getById re-checks branch and throws FORBIDDEN if out of scope.
Removing a profile that is its household's primaryContactProfileId also nulls the household's primaryContactProfileId (no dangling reference).
Freeze endDate must be strictly after startDate (BAD_REQUEST otherwise); an already-paused package cannot be frozen again.
creditsRemaining is a generated column = COALESCE(credits_unlocked,credits_total)-credits_used; cannot be written directly.
package_instances.purchase_number is globally unique.
assignTrainer requires status='pending' (else BAD_REQUEST); a 'failed' paymentStatus blocks assignment; trainer self-assign only with hierarchyScopeId==service branchId.
On purchased packages with approval gate ON, create() forces status='pending'; staff-assigned (source!=purchased) bypass the gate.
Installment-plan create scales totalPrice and taxAmount by (10000+price_premium_bps)/10000; createPackageInstance + createInstallmentSchedule are atomic.
No two non-cancelled appointments for the same trainer may overlap in time (EXCLUDE USING GIST appointments_trainer_no_overlap → CONFLICT).
No two non-cancelled appointments may share the same room overlapping in time (EXCLUDE USING GIST appointments_room_no_overlap).
appointments.booking_number is globally unique.
A booking against a package_instance with status='pending' is rejected (FORBIDDEN 'Package is awaiting trainer assignment').
reschedule allowed only for status∈{pending,confirmed,rescheduled}; credits never re-debited/reinstated on reschedule.
Class slot capacity must NOT be reduced below current spotsBooked (BAD_REQUEST); spotsAvailable=max(0,capacity-spotsBooked).
A client cannot be enrolled twice in the same slot (CONFLICT); enrollment blocked when isCancelled or spotsBooked>=capacity; cancel restores spot + 1 credit.
A drop-in check-in for the same client within 30 minutes is rejected as ALREADY_CHECKED_IN (CONFLICT); member-type check-ins require clientId.
